exposure: multiparous women with at least one previous cesarean section with a singleton pregnancy in cephalic presentation at 37 weeks or more
nulliparous women with a singleton pregnancy in cephalic presentation at 37 weeks or more who have started labor spontaneously
nulliparous women with a singleton pregnancy in cephalic presentation at 37 weeks or more undergoing labor induction before the onset of labor
cohort: The study included 9337 deliveries and 1507 cesareans performed at Inmaculada Local Hospital in Spain between January 1, 2006 and December 31, 2013.
finding: The study found that the cesarean section rate was 16.14%, and the highest rates were observed in nulliparous women with a singleton pregnancy in cephalic presentation at 37 weeks or more undergoing labor induction before the onset of labor (25.2%) and multiparous women with at least one previous cesarean section with a singleton pregnancy in cephalic presentation at 37 weeks or more (42.2%).
